name: Merging-unit analogue channel mapping
summary: Maps the local sensor connections to the assigned published digital measurement channels.
description: Maps the local sensor connections to the assigned published digital measurement channels. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Sensor terminal mapping” at the input and “Published channel identity” at the output. Wrong channel mapping changes the measurement meaning.
